feeds.title: Japan Camera Hunter
feeds.description: Welcome to JCH, where you can hopefully find your perfect film camera or lens. My name is Bellamy, and I love exploring the city, taking pictures and sharing my photographic knowledge with people.

feeds.title: 37 Frames Blog
feeds.description: See our recent real destination weddings, pre-weddings, elopements & engagements in Japan & worldwide. 37 Frames has grown into a talented & creative 'Collective' of very talented Photographers, Planners and wedding professionals to create your vision and record your love story, wherever that may take you.

feeds.title: TOPTIA Blog
feeds.description: I'm Tia Haygood, creator of TopTia Photography. I do portraits, events, food & product photography from the Tokyo area.

feeds.title: Nobechi Creative Blog
feeds.description: At Nobechi Creative, we create unique photography events, exhibitions, workshops & tours in Japan that take you deep into the local culture.

feeds.title: Photoguider-Japan Blog
feeds.description: I am Manabu. Photoguider means Photographer and Guide. I take travelers to many great view places in Kyoto, Osaka and Nara and take their pictures.

feeds.title: Bozphoto & Styles Blog
feeds.description: Bozphoto and styles is a studio specializing in wedding photography that deals with documentary wedding photography from all over Japan to overseas weddings, mainly in Tokyo.

feeds.title: Andrew Faulk Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Andrew. I am a commercial, editorial, portrait, and travel photographer based in Tokyo, Japan. My editorial work is frequently featured in a variety of international and domestic publications. I also work with some of the world's leading corporate and commercial brands.

feeds.title: Cristian Bucur Photography Blog
feeds.description: I'm Christian, I created this photography blog as a safe space to express my thoughts on photography and to share my experiences as a photographer. I provide photography services such as portrait, family, couple, vacation, pet portraits and more.

feeds.title: Shoot Tokyo Blog
feeds.description: A friendly photography blog from Tokyo. Dave Powell is the author and photographer behind the blog sharing his passion and creative works.

feeds.title: Lkaz Photo Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lukasz Palka. Born in Poland, raised in the US, and residing in Japan since 2008. I am an urban photographer. I photograph in multiple genres, street photography, urban landscape, urbex, and others. Though my work is varied, it is aimed at one goal: a personal portrait of a great city.

feeds.title: Sam Spicer Photography Blog
feeds.description: A blog about family portraits, wedding photography, travel and a bit of adventure too! By Sam Spicer- Natural Portrait and Wedding Photographer.

feeds.title: Tokyo Photographer Yasu's blog
feeds.description: Yasu is a Tokyo based photographer whose work mainly features family pictures and personal portraits.
